title: Main's checks-windows-guard shards get the 75-minute stopgap cap, so main's push runs finish
why: Main's push runs of checks.yml ended cancelled 11 times since run 42669400649 (Nov 9 11:56 CST); run 43038567637 cancelled at checks-windows-guard's 20-minute cap. No completed main push run since Nov 9 (retrospective health map 11:50 CST).
note: Owner 11:53 CST Nov 11 (plan f8b11c2, 3.2): the stopgap raise does not wait for the drain; he had already asked for it. Guard: step main-job-cap-alarm. Coordinator 11:56 CST Nov 11: a fix of a landed CI item, which the freeze allows. Per decision ci-job-caps (owner stopgap 2026-11-10 12:11 CST: raise caps generously), raise each checks-windows-guard shard cap to 75 min, add its row to the ci-job-caps table with the measured cap-end runs, close or update debt windows-shards-outgrow-caps. Weaken no test. CI-only. Own batch or a non-busy batch. Note: PR CI never runs shards -2/-3 (checks.yml near 1442-1444), so a PR cannot show a Windows guard cap end.
